I don't know which promptfoo provider to use for IBM-hosted models. The documents I was given don't mention IBM or any IBM provider, so I can't name one without guessing.

The documents do say that promptfoo "supports 60+ providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and many others:" [promptfoo/site/docs/getting-started.md]. The provider list itself isn't in what I have, so IBM may or may not be on it.

If IBM's endpoint is OpenAI-compatible, you might be able to use the approach the red-team quickstart describes for self-hosted servers: "For llamafile, vLLM, and Text Generation WebUI, keep the `openai:chat:` prefix, enter the server's model name, and set `apiBaseUrl` including `/v1`." [promptfoo/site/docs/red-team/quickstart.md]. The docs don't say this works for IBM, so check IBM's API compatibility and promptfoo's provider documentation first.
